query:
The chat seems to operate on an unspoken understanding that street events should keep their noise level reasonable so older neighbours are not disturbed. Does that understanding apply to everyone equally, and if not, who consistently pushes against it?

Options:
A. Constance
B. Reggie
C. Marek
D. Diane
context:
[1] (about=Constance, episodic, t12 @2025-04-14T19:22:00) I will be honest, it was a little loud. I retired upstairs before nine. I do prefer events that wind down by dusk, particularly midweek and on shared evenings.
[2] (about=Constance, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:23:00) Quietly is rather how this street tends to do its best work. Until Saturday.
[3] (about=Marek, episodic, t14 @2025-04-21T18:37:00) punch is fine. but listen, an AGM in the GARDEN should at least have music. quietly. just saying. 🎶
[4] (about=Marek, episodic, t10 @2025-04-07T19:15:00) side note: kids' birthday next sat, will be a bit loud probably 🎉. heads up rather than asking permission, will keep it before 10
[5] (about=Joel, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:18:00) ill bring the speaker. quiet music marek can come fight me 😂
[6] (about=Diane, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:21:00) Right then, Saturday May 17, my front garden, 2pm. Thank you all for the past several months. We have moved a lot, quietly. Henry, see you for the prep meet on Friday. D
[7] (about=Yara, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:04:00) ha! constance i was actually going to ask, can we have ten min at the start about the street's history? i've been digging through the photos you lent me and there's some lovely stuff worth sharing
[8] (about=Greg, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:14:00) no garden burning this year. council letter went out march. ill remind anyone who forgets
[9] (about=Owen, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:15:00) For clarity, any communication to the owner should be on behalf of the chat as a whole, not from a single resident. We should be careful that it does not read as harassment.
[10] (about=Constance, episodic, t12 @2025-04-14T19:18:00) Thinking about all of this, I will say I have softened slightly on the rentals after Diane's shift. A managed approach, perhaps a one-per-street limit, is something I could live with now, where two months ago I would have refused outright.
[11] (about=Marek, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:09:00) listen, more people on the street is fine by me 🔥 means more for the barbecue this summer 😂
[12] (about=Owen, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T18:49:00) Just to flag, the threshold should be defined per address, not per residence overall, otherwise it perversely punishes streets with multiple short-term rentals more leniently. The phrasing currently is ambiguous.

query:
The chat seems to assume that everyone helps out at the annual block barbecue in some way, even just by showing up. Does this apply equally to all members, or does at least one member visibly resist that expectation?

Options:
A. Owen
B. Joel
C. Tomás
D. Marek
context:
[1] (about=Owen, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:07:00) Sasha, I appreciate the invitation. Tell me numbers expected, please. If it is small, four to six, I will likely come. If it is more like fifteen, I will probably send my apologies.
[2] (about=Sasha, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:06:00) always 🙂 also can someone please remind owen we have a small house-warming for the new tenant on number 24 next sat tea-time, they were sort of invited via me but it's casual
[3] (about=Bex, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:09:00) owen come, sasha will need backup if there's only cheese platters on offer, you know they don't eat that 🧀😅
[4] (about=Marek, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:13:00) we will fix something for you sasha don't worry. plenty of options at the bbq too 🌽
[5] (about=Joel, episodic, t10 @2025-04-07T19:16:00) marek some of us have lectures sun morning 💀
[6] (about=Marek, episodic, t1 @2025-03-10T18:30:00) OK FOLKS spring barbecue is coming 🔥🔥 same as last year, my back garden, last sat in May, kicking off around 1pm and running until folks fall over. who's in?? 🍻 i need numbers by end of this week so i can sort the meat order. drinks BYO, kids welcome, dogs welcome, bring a chair if you have a fold-up one going spare 🪑
[7] (about=Marek, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:35:00) honestly diane just bring drinks. i'll handle meat 🥩🥩🥩
[8] (about=Greg, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:37:00) i mean i'll bring a tray of sausages. veg lot can do the salad
[9] (about=Lateefah, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:36:00) marek please don't only do meat, we have at least three veggies on the street. tomás, priya, mei. and i won't eat pork either way 🙏🙏
[10] (about=Diane, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:34:00) Right then, Marek, what do you need from us? Last year the catering bit got messy, let's avoid that. D
[11] (about=Aisling, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:19:00) ✨ what if we did a small write-up for the residents' association website about the corner protocol? would be a nice case study tbh
[12] (about=Diane, episodic, t7 @2025-03-31T19:00:00) Right then, last Monday of March. Quick wrap. Five incidents on the corner this month, escalation letter goes Wednesday. Spring barbecue is in eight weeks. Anything else for the month? D
[13] (about=Henry, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:45:00) I will list the dishes in the spreadsheet so we have a record. Easier to compare to last year's spend.
[14] (about=Priya, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:40:00) That works for me. Quick note: roughly a third of attendees historically don't eat much meat. Worth scaling accordingly.
